# icu

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of **icu** is to serve as Cero's catch all package of utility functions.

## Installation

You can install the development version of **icu** from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("iancero/icu")
```
